# Setup
```{r setup}
myPath <- "path_to_github" #ADD PATH TO GITHUB FOLDER

#import linear modeling functions
source(paste0(myPath,"/functions/linearModelingFunctions.R"))

```

# Data processing
```{r dataProcessing, eval=FALSE}
#### The following code is used to run this analysis from the raw data. Skip below to begin with the provided processed data file. ####

### download the fastq files and map with bowtie2 using the command:
# bowtie2 -x PATH_TO_GENOME -1 fastq1.gz -2 fastq2.gz --local --very-sensitive-local --no-unal --no-mixed --no-discordant --phred33 -I 10 -X 700 -S OUTPUT_FOLDER/SAMPLE_NAME.sam

### call CTCF and H3K4me3 using the command:
# macs2 callpeak -B -t EXPERIMENTAL_SAMPLE.BAM -c IGG_CONTROL.BAM --name SAMPLE_NAME --nomodel --extsize 185 -f BAMPE -g hs

### call H3K27me3 peaks using the command:
# macs2 callpeak -B -t EXPERIMENTAL_SAMPLE.BAM -c IGG_CONTROL.BAM --name SAMPLE_NAME --nomodel --extsize 185 -f BAMPE -g hs --broad

### generate the consensus peak set. bedtools is run via the command line (bash); other steps are in R. CTCF and H3K4me3 files from macs2 end with .narrowPeak; H3K27me3 will be .broadPeak
```

# Linear Modeling 
```{r linearModeling}
#### START HERE WITH PROCESSED NORMALIZED COUNTS DATA ####

# get metadata for all marks
metadata_all<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/metadata.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k27me3_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="H3K27me3",]
k4me3_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="H3K4me3",]
ctcf_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="CTCF",]
migg_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="mIgG3",]
prigg_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="pRIgG",]

# H3K4me3 over promoter regions
k4me3_tss1000_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K4me3/k4me3_tss1000_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k4me3_tss1000_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(k4me3_tss1000_normcounts,k4me3_meta, selectXY=TRUE)
write.table(k4me3_tss1000_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/K4me3/k4me3_tss1000_lm.txt'),sep='\t',  quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)

# H3K4me3 over consensus peak set (sex chromosome peaks only)
k4me3_allPeaks<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/consensusPeaks/H3K4me3_consensusPeakset_SAF.txt'), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names=1)
k4me3_XYPeaks_df<-k4me3_allPeaks[k4me3_allPeaks$Chr=="chrX" | k4me3_allPeaks$Chr=="chrY",]
k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Location<-NA
k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Location[k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Start < 2781479]<-"PAR1"
k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Location[k4me3_XYPeaks_df$End > 155701383 & k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Chr=="chrX"]<-"PAR2"
k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Location[k4me3_XYPeaks_df$End > 56887903 & k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Chr=="chrY"]<-"PAR2"
k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Location[k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Start >= 2781479 & k4me3_XYPeaks_df$End <= 155701383 & k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Chr=="chrX"]<-"NPX"
k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Location[k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Start >= 2781479 & k4me3_XYPeaks_df$End <= 56887903  & k4me3_XYPeaks_df$Chr=="chrY"]<-"NPY"
k4me3_XYPeaks_df$region<-rownames(k4me3_XYPeaks_df)
k4me3_XYPeaks<-rownames(k4me3_XYPeaks_df)

k4me3_k4Peaks_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K4me3/k4me3_k4Peaks_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k4me3_k4Peaks_normcounts_xy<-k4me3_k4Peaks_normcounts[rownames(k4me3_k4Peaks_normcounts) %in%k4me3_XYPeaks,]
k4me3_k4Peaks_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(k4me3_k4Peaks_normcounts_xy,k4me3_meta, selectXY=FALSE)
write.table(k4me3_k4Peaks_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/K4me3/k4me3_k4me3Peaks_lm.txt'),sep='\t',  quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)

# H3K4me3 over 1kb segments of chrX
k4me3_chrX1kb_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K4me3/k4me3_chrX1kb_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k4me3_chrX1kb_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(k4me3_chrX1kb_normcounts,k4me3_meta, selectXY=FALSE)
write.table(k4me3_chrX1kb_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/K4me3/k4me3_chrX1kb_lm.txt'), sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)

# H3K27me3 over bodies of protein coding genes
k27me3_pcg_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K27me3/k27me3_pcg_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k27me3_pcg_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(k27me3_pcg_normcounts,k27me3_meta, selectXY=TRUE)
write.table(k27me3_pcg_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/K27me3/k27me3_pcg_lm.txt'), sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)

# H3K27me3 over consensus peak set (sex chromosome peaks only)
k27me3_k27me3peaks_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K27me3/k27me3_k27me3peaks_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k27me3_k27me3peaks_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(k27me3_k27me3peaks_normcounts,k27me3_meta, selectXY=TRUE)
write.table(k27me3_k27me3peaks_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/K27me3/k27me3_k27me3peaks_lm.txt'), sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)

# H3K27me3 over 1 kb segments of chrX
k27me3_chrX1kb_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K27me3/k27me3_chrX1kb_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k27me3_chrX1kb_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(k27me3_chrX1kb_normcounts,k27me3_meta, selectXY=FALSE)
write.table(k27me3_chrX1kb_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/K27me3/k27me3_chrX1kb_lm.txt'), sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)

# CTCF over promoter regions
ctcf_tss1000_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/CTCF/ctcf_tss1000_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ctcf_tss1000_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(ctcf_tss1000_normcounts,ctcf_meta, selectXY=TRUE)
write.table(ctcf_tss1000_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/CTCF/ctcf_tss1000_lm.txt'),sep='\t',  quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)

# CTCF over consensus peak set (sex chromosome peaks only)
ctcf_allPeaks<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/consensusPeaks/CTCF_consensusPeakset_SAF.txt'), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names=1)
ctcf_XYPeaks_df<-ctcf_allPeaks[ctcf_allPeaks$Chr=="chrX" | ctcf_allPeaks$Chr=="chrY",]
ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Location<-NA
ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Location[ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Start < 2781479]<-"PAR1"
ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Location[ctcf_XYPeaks_df$End > 155701383 & ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Chr=="chrX"]<-"PAR2"
ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Location[ctcf_XYPeaks_df$End > 56887903 & ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Chr=="chrY"]<-"PAR2"
ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Location[ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Start >= 2781479 & ctcf_XYPeaks_df$End <= 155701383 & ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Chr=="chrX"]<-"NPX"
ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Location[ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Start >= 2781479 & ctcf_XYPeaks_df$End <= 56887903  & ctcf_XYPeaks_df$Chr=="chrY"]<-"NPY"
ctcf_XYPeaks_df$region<-rownames(ctcf_XYPeaks_df)
ctcf_XYPeaks<-rownames(ctcf_XYPeaks_df)

ctcf_ctcfPeaks_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/CTCF/ctcf_ctcfPeaks_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ctcf_ctcfPeaks_normcounts_xy<-ctcf_ctcfPeaks_normcounts[rownames(ctcf_ctcfPeaks_normcounts) %in%ctcf_XYPeaks,]
ctcf_ctcfPeaks_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(ctcf_ctcfPeaks_normcounts_xy,ctcf_meta, selectXY=FALSE)

write.table(ctcf_ctcfPeaks_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/CTCF/ctcf_ctcfPeaks_lm.txt'),sep='\t',  quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)

# CTCF over 1kb segments of chrX
ctcf_chrX1kb_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/CTCF/ctcf_chrX1kb_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ctcf_chrX1kb_lm<-to_run_lmanalysis(ctcf_chrX1kb_normcounts,ctcf_meta, selectXY=FALSE)
write.table(ctcf_chrX1kb_lm, file=paste0(myPath,'/linearModeling/raw/CTCF/ctcf_chrX1kb_lm.txt'), sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)
```

#Correct linear modeling and counts for IgG background
```{r igg correction}

##correct linear modeling results
k4me3_lmFiles<-data.frame(Sample=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/K4me3/k4me3_k4me3Peaks_lm.txt"), 
                                   paste0(myPath, "/linearModeling/raw/K4me3/k4me3_tss1000_lm.txt")),
                          IgG=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/pRIgG/prigg_k4me3Peaks_lm.txt"),
                                paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/pRIgG/prigg_tss1000_lm.txt")),
                          Name=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/K4me3/k4me3_k4me3Peaks_lm_corrected.txt"),
                                 paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/K4me3/k4me3_tss1000_lm_corrected.txt")))

k27me3_lmFiles<-data.frame(Sample=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/K27me3/k27me3_pcg_lm.txt")),
                          IgG=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/mIgG3/prigg_k27me3Peaks_lm.txt")),
                          Name=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/K27me3/k27me3_pcg_lm_corrected.txt")))

ctcf_lmFiles<-data.frame(Sample=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/CTCF/ctcf_ctcfPeaks_lm.txt"), 
                                   paste0(myPath, "/linearModeling/raw/CTCF/ctcf_tss1000_lm.txt")),
                          IgG=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/pRIgG/priggc_ctcfPeaks_lm.txt"),
                                paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/pRIgG/priggc_tss1000_lm.txt")),
                          Name=c(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/CTCF/ctcf_ctcfPeaks_lm_corrected.txt"),
                                 paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/CTCF/ctcf_tss1000_lm_corrected.txt")))


k4me3_new<-correctLM(k4me3_lmFiles, 0.391)
k27me3_new<-correctLM(k27me3_lmFiles,0.108)
ctcf_new<-correctLM(ctcf_lmFiles,0.418)

##correct counts files
metadata_all<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/metadata.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k27me3_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="H3K27me3",]
k4me3_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="H3K4me3",]
ctcf_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="CTCF",]
migg_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="mIgG3",]
prigg_meta<-metadata_all[metadata_all$Mark=="pRIgG",]

#K4me3
k4me3_k4Peaks_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K4me3/k4me3_k4Peaks_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
prigg_k4Peaks_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/deseq2/pRIgG/prigg_k4Peaks_normalizedcounts.txt"), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
k4me3_k4Peaks_counts_corrected<-getCorrectedCounts(k4me3_k4Peaks_normcounts, k4me3_meta, prigg_k4Peaks_normcounts, prigg_meta, scaleIgG=0.391)
write.table(k4me3_k4Peaks_counts_corrected, file=paste0(myPath,"/correctedCounts/K4me3/k4me3_k4Peaks_correctedCounts.txt"),sep='\t', quote=FALSE,row.names=TRUE)

k4me3_tss1000_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K4me3/k4me3_tss1000_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
prigg_tss1000_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"deseq2/pRIgG/prigg_tss1000_normalizedcounts.txt"), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
k4me3_tss1000_counts_corrected<-getCorrectedCounts(k4me3_tss1000_normcounts, k4me3_meta, prigg_tss1000_normcounts, prigg_meta, scaleIgG=0.391)
write.table(k4me3_tss1000_counts_corrected, file=paste0(myPath,"/correctedCounts/K4me3/k4me3_tss1000_correctedCounts.txt"),sep='\t', quote=FALSE,row.names=TRUE)

#K27me3
k27me3_pcg_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/K27me3/k27me3_pcg_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
migg_pcg_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/deseq2/mIgG3/migg_pcg_normalizedcounts.txt'), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_corrected<-getCorrectedCounts(k27me3_pcg_normcounts, k27me3_meta, migg_pcg_normcounts, migg_meta, scaleIgG=0.108)
write.table(k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_corrected, file=paste0(myPath,"/correctedCounts/K27me3/k27me3_pcg_correctedCounts.txt"),sep='\t', quote=FALSE,row.names=TRUE)

prigg_tss1000_normcounts<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/deseq2/pRIgG/prigg_tss1000_normalizedcounts.txt"), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
```
